group: Who has borrowed by selling bonds
title: Who has borrowed in Sweden by selling bonds: debt securities outstanding by kind of borrower, in US dollars

rows.name: Not split by the BIS
rows.basis: all borrowers minus the kinds of borrower (our calculation)

source: Bank for International Settlements, debt securities statistics (WS_NA_SEC_DSS 1.0), issued by residents, all maturities and currencies, nominal value, US dollars, Sweden (SE), quarterly
note: Each amount is the debt securities that borrowers resident in the country have issued, at home and abroad, at the amount they will repay, in US dollars at the BIS's exchange rate, so a row can move with the currency without any borrowing or repaying. It already contains that country's international debt securities, and it is part of the total credit books, so these are never added to either. Not split is the total minus the kinds of borrower the BIS lists. Source: Bank for International Settlements.
